overview_description.description: Liabify is a fintech company providing earned wage access and employee financial wellness solutions for modern workplaces. Its platform integrates with payroll systems, enabling employees to access earned salaries before payday while helping employers improve retention and productivity. Liabify focuses on reducing financial stress through flexible salary access, digital financial tools, and seamless payroll integration designed for businesses and workforce management platforms.

about_short_description.short_description: Liabify is a fintech platform offering earned wage access, payroll integration, and employee financial wellness solutions.

product.name: LiaPay App
product.description: A UAE employee finance application that combines payroll-linked wage access, prepaid card payments, transfers, savings, bill payments, loans, and financial management tools.

product.name: Earned Wage Access (EWA)
product.description: A payroll-linked service that lets eligible employees access a portion of wages already earned before payday, with repayment through an automatic payroll deduction.

product.name: Employer Payroll Integration
product.description: A service that connects an employer’s payroll and HR processes with LiaPay to administer wage access, salary deductions, and employee financial services.

product.name: LiaPay Prepaid Card
product.description: A digital and physical prepaid card linked to the LiaPay wallet for ATM withdrawals, in-store purchases, online transactions, and contactless payments.

product.name: Secured Loans
product.description: Financing products offered through LiaPay that use security or eligible benefits to support access to credit under applicable approval and repayment conditions.

product.name: LiaPay Saving Funds
product.description: Goal-based savings tools that let users create multiple funds and allocate fixed amounts or income percentages automatically toward defined financial objectives.
